definition: A software platform that allows users to build, train, or deploy AI models and applications through visual interfaces rather than writing code directly.
details: No-code AI platforms lower the barrier to building AI-powered applications, enabling domain experts without deep programming or ML expertise to prototype and deploy models or workflows.
story: Imagine teaching a friend to shoot a basketball. They miss, and you walk them backwards through the shot — elbow, wrist, release — to find what needs fixing. Think of it this way: A software platform that allows users to build, train, or deploy AI models and applications through visual interfaces rather than writing code directly. And here is the clever part: No-code AI platforms lower the barrier to building AI-powered applications, enabling domain experts without deep programming or ML expertise to prototype and deploy models or workflows. It is learning from every miss instead of repeating the same mistake. And that is No-Code AI Platform — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
